statement: Outside a thin subset of fourteen-tuples of Q-rational points, the arithmetic Galois group acts transitively on the 87,304 rational quintics through those points.

answer.text: Arithmetic action transitive outside a thin set; exact group not determined here.

source.location: Definition preceding Proposition2.2 and Proposition2.2, printed pages4–5; Conjecture1.5, printed page3
source.version: arXiv:1901.11294v2 (30 April 2020), primary PDF inspected 4 November 2026

scope: Arithmetic splitting-field Galois action for rational quintics through fourteen general Q-rational points, outside a thin exceptional set.

origin.inheritance_basis: Set e=5 in Proposition2.2; the fibre has N5=87304 elements.

notes:
Specialization e=5 of the family theorem. Transitivity is proved; full symmetry is only conjectured in this source. This result does not identify the geometric complex monodromy group.

Outside a thin subset of fourteen-tuples of Q-rational points, the arithmetic Galois action on the 87304 rational quintics through those points is transitive. The full symmetric group S87304 is conjectured in the source; an exact geometric monodromy identification is not extracted here.
